in_marathi.name: Samyak
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Perfect, Complete, Right
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samyak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Samyak means 'perfect', 'complete', or 'right' in Sanskrit and Hindi. It is a name that evokes a sense of harmony and balance, reflecting the idea that everything in the universe operates according to a perfect cosmic order.
